Business expense rules (Yarrow Logistics)
1. Finance may ask for a short business reason for any expense.
2. Conference and training fees: always need prior approval, whatever the amount; at most GBP 1,400.00 per event (exactly GBP 1,400.00 is accepted).
3. Receipts: a receipt must be attached to every expense whose total is above GBP 20.00 (GBP 20.00 itself does not count); private-car mileage never needs one.
4. Prior approval: an expense whose total is GBP 600.00 or more is paid only if it was approved beforehand.
5. Parking: no more than GBP 18.00 per day (exactly GBP 18.00 is accepted).
6. Unspent travel advances must be returned within 14 days after the trip.
7. Equipment: an item costing more than GBP 250.00 needs prior approval, in addition to any other approval rule in this policy.
8. Questions about this policy go to the finance team.
9. Private car: paid at GBP 0.33 per km driven; trips of 400 km or more are not paid at all; the amount claimed must not be higher than km driven x rate.
10. Hotels: room rate no more than GBP 120.00 per night (exactly GBP 120.00 is accepted).
Each expense must satisfy all rules relevant to it; one broken rule means it is not paid in full.

Corvane Systems - expense reimbursement policy
1. Prior approval: an expense whose total is CHF 500.00 or more is paid only if it was approved beforehand.
2. Deadline: an expense must be submitted within 30 days of its expense date (the expense date is day 0; a submission on day 30 is still in time).
3. Equipment: an item costing CHF 250.00 or more needs prior approval, in addition to any other approval rule in this policy.

7. Receipts: a receipt must be attached to every expense whose total is CHF 20.00 or more; private-car mileage never needs one.
8. Meals: the cost per person (the total divided by the number of people) may be below CHF 80.00 (exactly CHF 80.00 is not accepted); drinks containing alcohol are not paid for.
9. Flights: economy class; business class is allowed only when the scheduled flight time is more than 5 hours (exactly 5 hours is not enough).
An expense is paid back in full only when it complies with all of the rules relevant to it.

Business expense rules (Brightwater Analytics)
1. Deadline: an expense must be submitted within 60 days of its expense date (the expense date is day 0; a submission on day 60 is still in time).

9. Approved expenses are paid with the next monthly salary.
10. Exchange-rate differences are booked by finance and are never part of an expense.
An expense is paid back in full only when it complies with all of the rules relevant to it.

11. Private car: paid at EUR 0.36 per km driven; trips of more than 500 km are not paid at all (500 km itself is fine); the amount claimed must not be higher than km driven x rate.
If any rule relevant to an expense is broken, the expense is not paid back in full.

8. Expense reports are filed in the company's expense tool.
Rules written for a different kind of expense do not matter here; an expense is paid in full only when all rules relevant to it are met.

8. Conference and training fees: always need prior approval, whatever the amount; at most CAD 1,500.00 per event (exactly CAD 1,500.00 is accepted).

1. Prior approval: an expense whose total is above CHF 300.00 (CHF 300.00 itself does not count) is paid only if it was approved beforehand.

Only expenses that comply with every relevant rule are paid in full.

Travel and expense policy of Saffron Labs
1. Approved expenses are paid with the next monthly salary.
2. Corporate cards are issued on request; their monthly limit is SGD 7,500.00.
3. Conference and training fees: always need prior approval, whatever the amount; at most SGD 700.00 per event (exactly SGD 700.00 is accepted).
4. Equipment: an item costing more than SGD 200.00 needs prior approval, in addition to any other approval rule in this policy.
5. Flights: economy class; business class is allowed only when the scheduled flight time is 9 hours or more; every flight must be booked at least 10 days before departure (exactly 10 days is enough; the date of a flight expense is its booking date).
6. Client gifts: no more than SGD 25.00 per recipient (exactly SGD 25.00 is accepted); gift vouchers and cash are never paid for.
7. Unspent travel advances must be returned within 14 days after the trip.
8. Private car: paid at SGD 0.24 per km driven; trips of 600 km or more are not paid at all; the amount claimed must not be higher than km driven x rate.
9. Receipts: a receipt must be attached to every expense whose total is above SGD 10.00 (SGD 10.00 itself does not count); private-car mileage never needs one.
10. Other expense types: a type of expense not named in this policy is reimbursed if it meets the rules on receipts, prior approval and deadlines in this policy.
Each expense must satisfy all rules relevant to it; one broken rule means it is not paid in full.

10. Questions about this policy go to the finance team.
If any rule relevant to an expense is broken, the expense is not paid back in full.

7. Expense reports are filed in the company's expense tool.
8. Hotels: room rate no more than USD 190.00 per night (exactly USD 190.00 is accepted).
9. Equipment: an item costing USD 150.00 or more needs prior approval, in addition to any other approval rule in this policy.
An expense is paid back in full only when it complies with all of the rules relevant to it.

Veltra Health: what we reimburse

10. Parking: no more than SGD 35.00 per day (exactly SGD 35.00 is accepted).
An expense is paid back in full only when it complies with all of the rules relevant to it.

5. Receipts: a receipt must be attached to every expense whose total is EUR 40.00 or more; private-car mileage never needs one.
6. Exchange-rate differences are booked by finance and are never part of an expense.
7. Taxis: below EUR 40.00 per ride (exactly EUR 40.00 is not accepted); a ride is paid only if it starts at 20:00 or later or before 07:00.
8. Questions about this policy go to the finance team.
If any rule relevant to an expense is broken, the expense is not paid back in full.

4. Receipts: a receipt must be attached to every expense whose total is CAD 30.00 or more; private-car mileage never needs one.
5. Flights: economy class; business class is allowed only when the scheduled flight time is 9 hours or more; every flight must be booked at least 21 days before departure (exactly 21 days is enough; the date of a flight expense is its booking date).
6. Private car: paid at CAD 0.24 per km driven; trips of 200 km or more are not paid at all; the amount claimed must not be higher than km driven x rate.
If any rule relevant to an expense is broken, the expense is not paid back in full.

10. Deadline: an expense must be submitted within 45 days of its expense date (the expense date is day 0; a submission on day 45 is still in time).
11. Receipts: a receipt must be attached to every expense whose total is above CHF 15.00 (CHF 15.00 itself does not count).
If any rule relevant to an expense is broken, the expense is not paid back in full.

11. Parking: no more than CHF 20.00 per day (exactly CHF 20.00 is accepted).
Rules written for a different kind of expense do not matter here; an expense is paid in full only when all rules relevant to it are met.

2. Other expense types: a type of expense not named in this policy is reimbursed if it meets the rules on receipts, prior approval and deadlines in this policy.
3. Corporate cards are issued on request; their monthly limit is GBP 5,000.00.
4. Deadline: an expense must be submitted within 60 days of its expense date (the expense date is day 0; a submission on day 60 is still in time).
5. Prior approval: an expense whose total is GBP 1,000.00 or more is paid only if it was approved beforehand.
6. Conference and training fees: always need prior approval, whatever the amount.
7. Taxis: no more than GBP 40.00 per ride (exactly GBP 40.00 is accepted).
8. Meals: the cost per person (the total divided by the number of people) may be below GBP 45.00 (exactly GBP 45.00 is not accepted); drinks containing alcohol are not paid for.
9. Exchange-rate differences are booked by finance and are never part of an expense.
If any rule relevant to an expense is broken, the expense is not paid back in full.

Expense claims at Zenith Textiles: the rules
1. Unspent travel advances must be returned within 30 days after the trip.
2. Private car: paid at SGD 0.42 per km driven; trips of more than 300 km are not paid at all (300 km itself is fine); the amount claimed must not be higher than km driven x rate.
3. Prior approval: an expense whose total is above SGD 500.00 (SGD 500.00 itself does not count) is paid only if it was approved beforehand.
4. Other expense types: any type of expense not named in this policy is not reimbursed.
5. Deadline: an expense must be submitted within 90 days of its expense date (the expense date is day 0; a submission on day 90 is still in time).
6. Parking: no more than SGD 25.00 per day (exactly SGD 25.00 is accepted).
7. Meals: the cost per person (the total divided by the number of people) may be no more than SGD 55.00 (exactly SGD 55.00 is accepted); drinks containing alcohol are paid for only when a client attended the meal.
8. Corporate cards are issued on request; their monthly limit is SGD 5,000.00.
9. Client gifts: below SGD 50.00 per recipient (exactly SGD 50.00 is not accepted); gift vouchers and cash are never paid for.
10. Equipment: an item costing SGD 200.00 or more needs prior approval, in addition to any other approval rule in this policy.
If any rule relevant to an expense is broken, the expense is not paid back in full.

9. Parking: no more than CHF 30.00 per day (exactly CHF 30.00 is accepted).
10. Taxis: no more than CHF 30.00 per ride (exactly CHF 30.00 is accepted).
Rules written for a different kind of expense do not matter here; an expense is paid in full only when all rules relevant to it are met.

An expense is paid back in full only when it complies with all of the rules relevant to it.

9. Meals: the cost per person (the total divided by the number of people) may be below GBP 45.00 (exactly GBP 45.00 is not accepted); drinks containing alcohol are not paid for.
An expense is paid back in full only when it complies with all of the rules relevant to it.

2. Prior approval: an expense whose total is GBP 1,500.00 or more is paid only if it was approved beforehand.
3. Flights: economy class; business class is allowed only when the scheduled flight time is more than 8 hours (exactly 8 hours is not enough); every flight must be booked at least 14 days before departure (exactly 14 days is enough; the date of a flight expense is its booking date).
4. Mobile phone bills: no more than GBP 75.00 per month (exactly GBP 75.00 is accepted).
5. Unspent travel advances must be returned within 10 days after the trip.
6. Hotels: room rate below GBP 160.00 per night (exactly GBP 160.00 is not accepted); in Aarhus, Vienna or Geneva the limit is GBP 280.00 per night instead, with the same rule at the limit.
7. Taxis: no more than GBP 90.00 per ride (exactly GBP 90.00 is accepted).
8. Finance may ask for a short business reason for any expense.
9. Meals: the cost per person (the total divided by the number of people) may be below GBP 50.00 (exactly GBP 50.00 is not accepted); drinks containing alcohol are not paid for.
If any rule relevant to an expense is broken, the expense is not paid back in full.

1. Prior approval: an expense whose total is SGD 600.00 or more is paid only if it was approved beforehand.

3. Client gifts: no more than SGD 25.00 per recipient (exactly SGD 25.00 is accepted); gift vouchers and cash are never paid for.
4. Parking: no more than SGD 30.00 per day (exactly SGD 30.00 is accepted).

6. Meals: the cost per person (the total divided by the number of people) may be no more than SGD 25.00 (exactly SGD 25.00 is accepted); drinks containing alcohol are not paid for.
7. Other expense types: a type of expense not named in this policy is reimbursed if it meets the rules on receipts, prior approval and deadlines in this policy.
8. Conference and training fees: always need prior approval, whatever the amount; at most SGD 700.00 per event (exactly SGD 700.00 is accepted).
9. Equipment: an item costing more than SGD 150.00 needs prior approval, in addition to any other approval rule in this policy.
10. Finance may ask for a short business reason for any expense.
An expense is paid back in full only when it complies with all of the rules relevant to it.

Business expense rules (Halden Instruments)
1. Conference and training fees: always need prior approval, whatever the amount.

4. Taxis: no more than EUR 40.00 per ride (exactly EUR 40.00 is accepted); a ride is paid only if it starts at 21:00 or later or before 06:00.
5. Receipts: a receipt must be attached to every expense whose total is above EUR 50.00 (EUR 50.00 itself does not count).
6. Parking: no more than EUR 20.00 per day (exactly EUR 20.00 is accepted).
7. Prior approval: an expense whose total is above EUR 500.00 (EUR 500.00 itself does not count) is paid only if it was approved beforehand.
8. Questions about this policy go to the finance team.
9. Exchange-rate differences are booked by finance and are never part of an expense.
10. Equipment: an item costing EUR 400.00 or more needs prior approval, in addition to any other approval rule in this policy.
Rules written for a different kind of expense do not matter here; an expense is paid in full only when all rules relevant to it are met.

Question: Does Kalani's claim comply with all rules relevant to it?

Travel and expense policy of Ashgrove Partners
1. Equipment: an item costing EUR 100.00 or more needs prior approval, in addition to any other approval rule in this policy.
2. Meals: the cost per person (the total divided by the number of people) may be below EUR 35.00 (exactly EUR 35.00 is not accepted); drinks containing alcohol are paid for only when a client attended the meal.
3. Taxis: no more than EUR 60.00 per ride (exactly EUR 60.00 is accepted); a ride is paid only if it starts at 22:00 or later or before 06:00.
4. Deadline: an expense must be submitted within 60 days of its expense date (the expense date is day 0; a submission on day 60 is still in time).
5. Receipts: a receipt must be attached to every expense whose total is EUR 25.00 or more.
6. Questions about this policy go to the finance team.
7. Hotels: room rate no more than EUR 180.00 per night (exactly EUR 180.00 is accepted); in Helsinki or Ghent the limit is EUR 290.00 per night instead, with the same rule at the limit.
8. Expense reports are filed in the company's expense tool.
9. Prior approval: an expense whose total is EUR 600.00 or more is paid only if it was approved beforehand.
10. Flights: economy class; business class is allowed only when the scheduled flight time is more than 6 hours (exactly 6 hours is not enough); every flight must be booked at least 7 days before departure (exactly 7 days is enough; the date of a flight expense is its booking date).
11. Exchange-rate differences are booked by finance and are never part of an expense.
An expense is paid back in full only when it complies with all of the rules relevant to it.

6. Equipment: an item costing more than SGD 300.00 needs prior approval, in addition to any other approval rule in this policy.
An expense is paid back in full only when it complies with all of the rules relevant to it.
